name: leanscale-gtm
description: Ten GTM and RevOps agents that run against your own Salesforce or HubSpot. Read-only by default. Built by LeanScale.

plugins.name: semantic-layer
plugins.description: Walks you through defining your GTM metrics and writes them out as a real semantic layer: a git repo of versioned metric files, each with one named owner and a declared source of truth, seeded from your actual CRM stages and fields. Read-only against the CRM.

plugins.name: crm-hygiene
plugins.description: Audits the integrity of your CRM: duplicate accounts and contacts, dead fields, records owned by people who left, stale pipeline, orphaned contacts, and picklist rot. Produces a Hygiene Index and a fix list. Read-only.

plugins.name: pipeline-inspection
plugins.description: Finds the open deals violating your own rules — stuck in stage past your measured median, no next step, close date pushed three times, single-threaded, past due. A manager's call list, not a forecast. Read-only.

plugins.name: forecast-agent
plugins.description: Audits whether your CRM can support a forecast at all, then calls it three ways with the method shown. Scores forecast integrity and surfaces the gap between the rep-called commit and the evidence. Read-only.

plugins.name: sales-coach
plugins.description: Scores calls against your qualification framework — MEDDPICC, BANT, SPICED or your own — and rolls them into one team pattern report for the manager, with verbatim evidence and timestamps. Read-only.

plugins.name: customer-health
plugins.description: Scores every account twice, on sentiment and on commercial risk, because they diverge — the account that churns is often the happy one with an unsigned renewal. Captures a kickoff baseline so later runs prove movement. Read-only.

plugins.name: meeting-to-crm
plugins.description: Turns each call into proposed CRM updates — next step, qualification fields, new stakeholders — as an approvable diff. Dry-run by default, strict field allow-list, every applied write logged.

plugins.name: stage-architect
plugins.description: Derives what your pipeline stages actually mean from your own closed history and contrasts it with what your team believes. Finds skipped stages, stages that don't discriminate, and proposes buyer-verifiable exit criteria. Read-only.

plugins.name: lead-source
plugins.description: Measures whether your lead source data can be trusted: null and Other rates, near-duplicate values, and whether source survives the lead-to-opportunity conversion. Source integrity, not multi-touch attribution. Read-only.

plugins.name: system-map
plugins.description: Inventories what is actually wired into your CRM — integration users, connected apps, flows, triggers, scheduled jobs — and finds orphaned automation and multiple automations writing the same field. Read-only metadata.

plugins.name: executive-reporting
plugins.description: Builds the executive GTM reporting pack leadership runs the business on — bookings, created pipeline, coverage, cohort conversion, retention and concentration, each against a goal and each openable to the rows underneath. Audits whether the CRM can support the reporting before it publishes a number. Read-only.
